description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to learn how to manually do what an existing Claude skill does, or when they want to understand the underlying process of any capability Claude performs automatically. Triggers include: "how can I learn to do X?", "what do I need to know to do X without Claude?", "teach me what the X skill does", or any request for a personalized learning path for a specific capability. Also use proactively if the user mentions wanting to develop new skills, become more valuable at work, or reduce dependency on tools they don't control. Do NOT trigger for content generation requests ("write me a post", "make me a document") or factual questions ("what is X?") — those are not learning requests.
